_meta.note: Western 12 zodiac signs. All copy is original English. Compatibility cross-references sign codes.

signs.name: Aries
signs.traits: The trailblazer of the zodiac: bold, direct, and always first off the line. You act on instinct and thrive on a challenge, bouncing back from setbacks faster than anyone. Honest to a fault, you wear your heart on your sleeve.
signs.love: You fall fast and chase hard. Straight-up passion beats mind games, so you shine with a partner who keeps things fresh and exciting.
signs.work: Built for pioneering roles: launching, pitching, leading from the front. Routine bores you, but a fast-moving challenge brings out your best.
signs.money: You earn and spend on impulse, so an automatic savings plan keeps your momentum from outrunning your wallet.
signs.advice: Take three breaths before you charge. That one pause turns raw energy into real results.
signs.oneline: You've already taken the first step before others stop to think.

signs.name: Taurus
signs.traits: Calm, grounded, and ruled by the senses, you savor comfort and quality in everything. Once you commit, you keep going long after others quit. Gentle on the surface, unshakably stubborn at the core.
signs.love: You build love slowly and value security and affection above all. Loyal to the end, you treasure a partner who feels like home.
signs.work: You excel at steady, hands-on work that rewards patience and craft. Give you a stable lane and your staying power is unmatched.
signs.money: One of the zodiac's best savers. You grow wealth steadily, just remember to treat yourself now and then.
signs.advice: If you've settled into your comfort zone, open one new door. Fresh comfort waits on the other side of change.
signs.oneline: Slow is fine. Never stopping is your real strength.

signs.name: Gemini
signs.traits: Curious, quick-witted, and endlessly social, you collect ideas and people with ease. You read the room fast and adapt to anyone, and boredom is your one true enemy. A playful, ever-changing creature of the air.
signs.love: You're won over by clever conversation and mental sparks. You last with a partner who keeps things lively and never lets things grow stale.
signs.work: Made for roles that talk, write, and connect: PR, sales, media. The more variety and new faces, the more you thrive.
signs.money: A savvy bargain-hunter, but your scattered interests invite overspending, so set priorities for what's worth it.
signs.advice: Pick one interest and go deep. Your range plus one mastered skill makes you unstoppable.
signs.oneline: There's too much you want to know, and never enough day.

signs.name: Cancer
signs.traits: Warm-hearted and deeply caring, you can't leave a struggling person alone. Your empathy reads the subtlest shift in someone's mood, and you treasure a safe place to belong. Tender and easily moved, your kindness is your greatest charm.
signs.love: Homey and devoted, you want a deep, secure bond. Slow to open up, but once you trust, you love like family.
signs.work: A natural in caring roles: nursing, teaching, support, hospitality. You become the emotional backbone of any team.
signs.money: A steady saver for home and loved ones, you spend generously on the people who matter most.
signs.advice: Fill your own cup before pouring for others. When you smile, everyone around you warms up too.
signs.oneline: For the people you love, you can be stronger than you know.

signs.name: Leo
signs.traits: Bright, bold, and born for the spotlight, you turn attention into fuel. Big-hearted and generous, you catch fire the moment someone relies on you. Proud yet sincere, your sunny optimism lights up every room.
signs.love: Passionate and devoted, you blaze brighter when praised and admired. You click with a partner who expresses love openly and warmly.
signs.work: You shine in visible, leading roles: management, performance, hospitality. Recognition pushes you to give 120 percent.
signs.money: Generous and image-conscious, you earn well, so reining in show-off spending fills the savings fast.
signs.advice: Showing your soft side won't dim your shine. People are drawn to the real you most of all.
signs.oneline: You never hand over the lead, and that's exactly why people follow.

signs.name: Virgo
signs.traits: Precise, observant, and quietly perfectionist, you catch the details everyone else misses. Sincere and dependable, you finish what you start, though you can be hard on yourself. Modest but indispensable.
signs.love: You close the distance slowly and sincerely. Swap nitpicking for appreciation and your love life flows.
signs.work: A natural where accuracy and care count: accounting, editing, quality, healthcare. You raise the whole team's standard.
signs.money: A meticulous manager who wastes little, just don't let worry keep your wallet shut when spending is wise.
signs.advice: You don't need a perfect 100. The courage to ask for help at 70 makes life lighter.
signs.oneline: Your sharp, caring eye is your greatest weapon.

signs.name: Libra
signs.traits: Balanced, refined, and sociable, you love beauty and fairness and treat everyone evenly. A natural peacemaker, you read the air and smooth over conflict, though pleasing everyone leaves your own choices last.
signs.love: You favor smart, stylish romance and a graceful mood. You last with a partner you can be a little selfish with.
signs.work: You shine where people and beauty need balancing: hospitality, HR, design. Your gift for mediation is one of a kind.
signs.money: You love quality and looking good, so pause and ask if it's truly needed before you buy.
signs.advice: Put your own 'I like this' first. Your honest choice makes everyone around you comfortable too.
signs.oneline: You craft the 'just right' that puts everyone at ease.

signs.name: Scorpio
signs.traits: Intense beneath a cool surface, you burn hotter than anyone once you commit. Laser-focused and fiercely loyal, you see straight through people and despise shallow ties. Secretive but devoted, you love and remember deeply.
signs.love: Deep, intense, and all-in, you give everything once you're serious. Slow to open, but the bond you form runs deepest of all.
signs.work: Built to go deep: research, investigation, specialist craft, counseling. Your focus makes you a true expert.
signs.money: A disciplined saver who locks onto a target and hits it with quiet, relentless determination.
signs.advice: Put the feelings you bottle up into words with someone you trust. The more you release, the freer you feel.
signs.oneline: Beneath the calm face burns a fire hotter than anyone's.

signs.name: Sagittarius
signs.traits: A free-spirited adventurer, you leap toward new worlds with light feet and an open mind. Broad-visioned and upbeat, you ride out trouble on 'it'll work out.' Lose your freedom and you cool off fast.
signs.love: You last in a relationship that respects freedom. You're drawn to a partner you can grow and explore the world with.
signs.work: You blossom in roles that widen the world: travel, education, trade, sport. The more change and challenge, the better.
signs.money: You spend freely on experiences and trips, so let an auto-deposit quietly build your base.
signs.advice: Now and then, land your wings in one spot. Seeing something through makes your freedom even stronger.
signs.oneline: A view you haven't seen yet is always calling your name.

signs.name: Capricorn
signs.traits: Hardworking and responsible, you climb toward your goals one steady step at a time. Realistic and disciplined, you never act on a whim and always deliver. Slow to open your heart, but a quiet ambition burns within.
signs.love: You close the distance slowly and steadily, loving long and loyally once committed. Behind the reserve is a devoted heart.
signs.work: You shine where trust compounds: management, public service, expertise. You build status the longer you go.
signs.money: One of the zodiac's most prudent savers and long-term builders, just spend on today's joys sometimes too.
signs.advice: To the one always climbing: pause now and then and truly praise how far you've come.
signs.oneline: You never take the shortcut, and that's how you go the distance.

signs.name: Aquarius
signs.traits: Original and free-thinking, you see the world your own way, unbound by precedent. You treat everyone as an equal, regardless of title, and chase new ideas and tech. Logical on the surface, with a humanitarian heart underneath.
signs.love: You prefer an equal, friendship-style bond. The ideal is being each other's best friend before lovers.
signs.work: You shine where new value is created: tech, research, the creative and strategic. The more uncharted, the sharper your edge.
signs.money: Little attachment to money itself; you invest in gadgets and learning over brand-name flexing.
signs.advice: Before you reason it out, share the raw feeling too. Your honesty closes the distance fast.
signs.oneline: You'd rather be yourself than be like everyone else.

signs.name: Pisces
signs.traits: Gentle and dreamy, you feel others' pain as your own, the zodiac's great empath. Rich in imagination, you lose yourself in art and music and blend into the moods around you. Soft and giving, your boundless kindness heals many.
signs.love: A devoted romantic, you give your all for the one you love. Choose a sincere partner who cherishes you back, and happiness follows.
signs.work: A natural where feeling and care matter: art, music, welfare, healing. You shine wherever hearts need tending.
signs.money: Soft-hearted spending can slip away, so an auto-deposit and a little support keep your base safe.
signs.advice: Include yourself among the people you're kind to. A boundary isn't coldness, it's self-love.
signs.oneline: Kindness isn't weakness. It's your greatest gift.
